description: Hard palate and velum norms (mm) from published measurements, held against the procedural palate and velum by tests/palate.test.js through src/geometry/palate-measures.js.

tomaszewska2014.citation: Tomaszewska IM, Tomaszewski KA, Kmiotek EK, Pena IZ, Urbanik A, Nowakowski M, Walocha JA (2014) Anatomical landmarks for the localization of the greater palatine foramen - a study of 1200 head CTs, 150 dry skulls, systematic review of literature and meta-analysis. Journal of Anatomy 225(4), 419-435. doi:10.1111/joa.12221
tomaszewska2014.material: 150 dry adult skulls and 1200 adult head CT scans, pooled (Table 1, palatal vault length)
tomaszewska2014.definition: orale-staphylion: midline length of the hard palate, from the point behind the upper central incisors to the posterior nasal spine

perry2014.citation: Perry JL, Kotlarek KJ, Sutton BP, Kuehn DP, Jaskolka MS, Fang X, Point SW, Rauccio F. Variations in velopharyngeal structure in adults with repaired cleft palate. Cleft Palate-Craniofacial Journal 53(1), e1-e13 (online 2014). doi:10.1597/14-015
perry2014.material: 30 adults without cleft palate, 15 men and 15 women, aged 19-66 (Table 2, noncleft group)
perry2014.definition: velar length: curvilinear, from the posterior border of the hard palate through the middle of the velum to the tip of the uvula; velar thickness: from the oral surface to the velar knee, the greatest across it; midsagittal MRI at rest

kollara2016.citation: Kollara L, Perry JL, Hudson S (2016) Racial variations in velopharyngeal and craniometric morphology in children: an imaging study. Journal of Speech, Language, and Hearing Research 59(1), 27-38. doi:10.1044/2015_JSLHR-S-14-0236
kollara2016.material: 32 children aged 4-8, 16 White and 16 Black; means adjusted for head circumference (Table 5). low and high are the means of boys and of girls pooled over both groups; the groups themselves span 22.4-31.0 mm in length and 6.3-8.8 mm in thickness
kollara2016.definition: velar length: curvilinear, from the posterior nasal spine through the middle of the velum to the tip of the uvula; velar thickness: from the velar knee to the velar dimple

z-anatomy.name: Z-Anatomy (CC BY-SA 4.0), maxilla and upper teeth meshes, measured by experiments/issue-9-palate-za.mjs; only these numbers are kept
z-anatomy.definition: vault height: the oral palate surface on the midline above the midpoint of the occlusal cusps of the first and second upper molars
